name: sudoku-solver-component-tests
description: Unit tests for the shared UI components in web/ui/. Vitest rather than node --test, because these are .tsx: tests/engine's Node type-stripping cannot compile JSX, and Vite (already a dependency of the build) can. Kept apart from tests/ui, which drives whole pages through jsdom, and from tests/engine, which is pure logic. `vite` is listed here explicitly even though vitest brings its own: reached only as a peer, npm eagerly installs vite's optional peer `lightningcss` and writes its platform binaries into the lockfile as required, which makes `npm ci` fail with EBADPLATFORM on any machine but the one that wrote the lock.
